title: Create a sandbox version: response
description: 201 to step 1. The CLI PUTs the bundle to uploadUrl with uploadHeaders (step 2). No uploadUrl: the server already has a bundle with that SHA-256, so step 2 is skipped. Errors: 400 bad manifest, 401/403 bad key, 404 sandboxes off for the project, 413 bundle over the limit; each with a JSON body { error }.

uploadUrl.description: Where to PUT the tar.gz, e.g. a presigned storage URL. Absolute http(s).

uploadHeaders.description: Headers the PUT must send as they are, e.g. content-type.
